Security assessment

Define the work before the quote.

Scoping questions

  • Which applications, APIs, networks, or cloud assets are authorized?
  • What exclusions, test windows, and stop conditions apply?
  • What report and retest requirements would be useful?

Typical working outputs

  • Security assessment: An executive risk summary and a technical improvement roadmap.
  • Authorized red teaming: A scenario report connecting observations, defensive gaps, impact, and retest priorities.
  • Vulnerability assessment: An evidence-based findings report with severity context, owners, and verification guidance.

The proposal defines the agreed assets, approach, deliverables, dependencies, timing, exclusions, and commercial terms. Platform availability and licensing options require confirmation. Response support and scheduling are agreed separately.
